default/30652.htm.text: Uruha: The myth that you believed until this day, is all wrong. Let's study the truth of Grand Kain and Shilen together! And let's bring life again to this rotten world!

Q00215_TrialOfThePilgrim/30652-01.html.text: Uruha: Why are you wasting your time on them? They are just some miserable fellows who are confused by the ramblings of that hypocrite Einhasad. With help from Shilen and Gran Kain, they could live once more... You are not one of those silly followers of Eva, are you?

links.text: "I only came here at the request of Andellia."

Q00215_TrialOfThePilgrim/30652-03.html.text: Uruha: The malignant spirit of Shilen? The devourer of innocents? Please, leave these miserable creatures alone. They have suffered enough.

Q00215_TrialOfThePilgrim/30652-02.html.text: Uruha: Ah ha! That arrogant and reckless follower of Eva! Are you blind? Isn't the indecisiveness of Eva obvious?
